runs.data/p7-20261020-dev-01: Development batch (p7_batch --stage dev --development, 6 runs) on the pre-registration commit 4fd31d7a: q4-D0.3-g0.05-A45 T0 (success), q4-D0.6-g0.15-A0 T1a3 (flight failure: 46.3 deg after the 4th interruption, altitude loss 1.53 m), r01-A0 T1a3 (success), and MC_RAPTOR_RREC = 2: h-v2.0-D1.0-A0, h-M2-A45, h-v2.5-D1.4-A0 (all success). Max applied-command age 4 ms (h-v2.5-D1.4: 8 ms). Finding: the research_recovery rows of the FIRST recovery of every RREC run were missing (the topic was first advertised at that recovery's START and the logger subscribed ~0.3-0.4 s later; the first logged row was already the END or a later STEP). Logged segments: replay residual <= 2.4e-7 m, reconstruction of policy_input with the virtual-target rows exact; all mismatches lie before the first logged recovery row.
runs.data/p7-20261020-dev-02: Development batch on commit a2d7227c (research_recovery advertised at start), same 6 conditions, new seeds: all 6 succeed (q4-D0.6-g0.15 T1a3 succeeds here while it failed in dev-01: seed-to-seed variation, development only). Max applied-command age 4 ms, 8 ms in q4-D0.6-g0.15 and h-v2.5-D1.4 (<= 8 ms rule met). Every recovery complete in the log (replay residual <= 2.4e-7; p7_export reconstruction with the virtual-target rows: 0 components > 1e-4, residual <= 1.3e-7; ~2,100 virtual-target cycles per single-interruption RREC run). Catch-up (END CONVERGED) 8.71 s (v2.0 D1.0), 8.53 s (v2.5 D1.4), 7.90 s after the 4th resume of M2-A45 (earlier recoveries ended by the next interruption, STALE). Finding: in h-M2-A45 the batch-time p7_metrics flagged '1 recovery starts not at a resume': in the setup hover RAPTOR's activation followed a pre-stream setpoint within 200 ms, so its later hover timeout was an in-flight capture by the pre-registered definition and the stream start became a recovery start that converged in the same cycle (no STEP row: the network never observed a virtual target). p7_metrics now records such zero-step starts (starts_not_at_a_resume_without_virtual_target_cycles) and flags only starts with virtual-target cycles outside a resume.

fixes_before_freezing: PX4 (tools/apply_research.py): research_recovery is advertised at module start (no behaviour change; logging only).

config/p7.json: p7.task_failure_criterion added (task text: tilt > 45 deg or altitude loss > 1 m), reported by p7_metrics as task_outcome next to the unchanged frozen flight outcome, after dev-01 showed a 1.53 m altitude loss.
tools/p7_report.py added (analysis only); p7_metrics falls back to the repo config for task_failure_criterion.

tools/p7_metrics.py after dev-02: starts outside a planned resume with no virtual-target cycle (END CONVERGED in the start cycle) are recorded, not flagged (analysis only). The final candidate differs from dev-02's only in this file, so dev-02 serves as the latency and evidence check of the flight code.
note: Development run directories keep their metrics from batch time (never re-run in place); the dev-02 h-M2-A45 p7-metrics.json therefore still lists the old problem.
